primary_title: Agonist-dependent desensitization of the kappa opioid receptor by G protein receptor kinase and beta-arrestin
decision_basis: Primary site-mutant and mammalian corroboration support KOR pS369 as a functional determinant of beta-arrestin-2-dependent desensitization/internalization.
limitations_preserved: Preserve rat KOR pS369, GRK3/5 and ARRB2 context, functional-support rather than direct-docking semantics, and no SCI/terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Arrestin binds to different phosphorylated regions of the thyrotropin-releasing hormone receptor with distinct functional consequences
decision_basis: Primary arrestin3-GFP binding, receptor-region mutagenesis/truncation and arrestin-null rescue assays support the TRHR1 proximal S/T355-S/T365 region as a beta-arrestin-2 recruitment and desensitization/internalization determinant.
limitations_preserved: Preserve TRHR1, TRH, proximal region, ARRB2/arrestin3, site-set semantics, mouse-null rescue/HEK293 context and no SCI/terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Arrestin binds to different phosphorylated regions of the thyrotropin-releasing hormone receptor with distinct functional consequences
decision_basis: Primary arrestin3-GFP binding and receptor-region mutagenesis/truncation assays support the TRHR1 distal S/T370-S/T412 region as a beta-arrestin-2 binding determinant with distinct consequences from the proximal desensitization/internalization region.
limitations_preserved: Preserve TRHR1, TRH, distal region, ARRB2/arrestin3, binding-versus-function separation, mouse-null rescue/HEK293 context and no SCI/terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Internalization of the m2 muscarinic acetylcholine receptor. Arrestin-independent and -dependent pathways
decision_basis: Primary mutant/binding assays support the CHRM2 ICL3 TVSTS 307-311 cluster as a phosphorylation-dependent arrestin-1 binding and desensitization determinant.
limitations_preserved: Preserve ARRB1 historical arrestin-2 mapping, cluster-level semantics, arrestin-independent basal internalization, human HEK-tsA201 context, and no SCI/terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Internalization of the m2 muscarinic acetylcholine receptor. Arrestin-independent and -dependent pathways
decision_basis: Primary mutant/binding assays support the CHRM2 ICL3 TVSTS 307-311 cluster as a phosphorylation-dependent arrestin-2 binding and desensitization determinant.
limitations_preserved: Preserve ARRB2 historical arrestin-3 mapping, cluster-level semantics, arrestin-independent basal internalization, human HEK-tsA201 context, and no SCI/terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Distinct phosphorylation sites in SST2A somatostatin receptor determine beta-arrestin binding and receptor internalization
decision_basis: Primary Thr-site mutant assays support the SSTR2 T353/T354-containing threonine cluster as a beta-arrestin-1 association/internalization determinant.
limitations_preserved: Preserve rat sst2A, review-supported ARRB1 isoform mapping, cluster-level and nonexclusive site semantics, and no SCI/terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Distinct phosphorylation sites in SST2A somatostatin receptor determine beta-arrestin binding and receptor internalization

primary_title: Role of the C terminus in neuropeptide Y Y1 receptor desensitization and internalization
decision_basis: Y1R truncation and beta-arrestin2-GFP assays support the Ser352-to-Ser360 C-terminal regulatory region as a bounded beta-arrestin-2 recruitment/desensitization determinant.
limitations_preserved: Preserve region-level rather than single-site semantics, rat Y1R, NPY and beta-arrestin2-GFP context, and no SCI/terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Beta-arrestin 2-mediated internalization of the dopamine D1 receptor is regulated by phosphorylation sites in the third intracellular loop
decision_basis: Modern mutant/translocation assays support the DRD1 ICL3 S256/S258/S259 site-set as a beta-arrestin-2 internalization/translocation determinant, with earlier review-cited phosphorylation evidence.
limitations_preserved: Preserve ICL3 support semantics, rat D1R, dopamine, C-terminal-site distinction, and no SCI/terminal-TF inference.

decision_basis: Mutant/trafficking evidence supports the HTR4/5-HT4A S/T347-S/T355 C-terminal cluster as a beta-arrestin-2-associated internalization determinant.
limitations_preserved: Preserve cluster-level phosphosite semantics, HTR4A agonist and heterologous-cell context, and no individual-site, SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Protein kinase C mediates phosphorylation, desensitization, and trafficking of the D2 dopamine receptor.
decision_basis: PKC-phosphorylated D2R ICL3 domains support beta-arrestin-2- and dynamin-dependent internalization in the bounded primary model.
limitations_preserved: Preserve rat D2R ICL3 domain-level semantics, PKC/dopamine and beta-arrestin/dynamin context, and no single-site, SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Rapid dephosphorylation of G protein-coupled receptors by protein phosphatase 1beta is required for termination of beta-arrestin-dependent signaling
decision_basis: Cellular knockdown and phosphosite time-course evidence supports PPP1CB/PP1beta dephosphorylation of the rat sst2A ^353TTETQRT^359 beta-arrestin-acceptor cluster.
limitations_preserved: Preserve rat sst2A, SS-14, phosphatase/substrate and cluster semantics; no direct docking motif or SCI/terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Agonist-induced internalization of the platelet-activating factor receptor is dependent on arrestins but independent of G-protein activation. Role of the C terminus and the (D/N)PXXY motif
decision_basis: C-terminal deletion/minigene competition and arrestin-2 perturbation support the PTAFR 318-330 region as a beta-arrestin-1 association/trafficking determinant.
limitations_preserved: Preserve human PAFR, historical arrestin-2 to ARRB1 mapping, residues 318-330, PAF/COS-7 context and region-level semantics.

primary_title: Agonist-induced internalization of the platelet-activating factor receptor is dependent on arrestins but independent of G-protein activation. Role of the C terminus and the (D/N)PXXY motif
decision_basis: Co-immunoprecipitation/translocation and deletion mapping support shared PTAFR 318-330 association with historical arrestin-3/ARRB2.
limitations_preserved: Preserve human PAFR, historical arrestin-3 to ARRB2 mapping, residues 318-330, PAF/COS-7 context and weaker isoform-specific functional evidence.

primary_title: Key phosphorylation sites for robust beta-arrestin2 binding at the MOR revisited
decision_basis: GRK-edited HEK293 primary data support the MOR pS375/pT376/pT379 multisite barcode as a robust beta-arrestin2 recruitment determinant.
limitations_preserved: Preserve mouse MOR, multisite pS375/pT376/pT379, high-efficacy opioid and GRK2/3 context; no single-site sufficiency, SCI or terminal-TF inference.
